prompts: Create a new FOUR-PANEL illustration atlas for the opening of a narrative mystery game, matching the attached illustrations as CHARACTER AND STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal landscape panels, the same-sized quadrants filling a 3:2 landscape canvas, thin cream gutters at the exact central grid lines. No inset frames or extra panels. Match the existing handmade graphite and wax-crayon texture, cream paper, soft ochre, muted sage, dusty blue and rose; calm literary Japanese mystery, understated expressions, no photorealism, no 3D. Character reference: Nobuko is a bob-haired young adult woman with round glasses, ochre coat over a black top and canvas shoulder bag. Young shrine keeper Miyazaki wears sage green and ivory robes. Older helper Jiang has tousled gray hair, stubble, blue work jacket and neck towel. Writer Ishikawa has a short side-parted dark bob with a slim hairpin and muted plum jacket. Kato is a mustached man with swept-back dark hair in tan suit. Emi has a pinned-up dark hairstyle, pale floral kimono with dusty coral outer layer. Maintain all faces and costumes. Never depict twins, masks, exposed secret identities or a culprit reveal. NO TEXT, LETTERS, CAPTIONS, SPEECH BALLOONS, numbers or UI. These are illustration assets, not a screen design. New atlas A, quiet daytime and evening setup. TOP LEFT: a close over-shoulder view of Nobuko alone packing before her journey, her hands gently folding an old silk cloth bearing simple ink sketches of TWO separate incomplete jade pendants, her canvas bag and an empty tea cup nearby, subdued morning light, a feeling of an absent friend, no corpse, no photo with extra character. TOP RIGHT: afternoon at a small mountain shrine gate, Nobuko meets Kato and Emi for the first time, all THREE adults visible and exchanging a quiet nod, old stone steps, cedar trees and hazy pale-blue lake far below. BOTTOM LEFT: inside a wooden guesthouse corridor, young Miyazaki politely welcomes Nobuko while older Jiang gestures toward the guest room, THREE characters, ordinary warm hospitality, no ominous symbols or clues. BOTTOM RIGHT: after dinner, at Nobuko's open guest-room door, writer Ishikawa in plum introduces herself with a modest smile and a closed notebook held at her side, Nobuko standing in the doorway, TWO characters, warm room light and dusk outside. Keep each panel a distinct complete camera shot. Clear faces and readable hands, generous simple shapes suitable for a small mobile display.
